description: [PREMIUM — needs an API key: call hl_request_free_key first for a free key, or pay per call via x402] Analytics for HIP-3 (builder-deployed) perp markets such as RWA/equity perps: volume, open interest, funding, and 24h change, enumerated across builder dexs. Optionally pass `spotRefs` (coin→external spot price) to compute basis vs an external reference. Analytics only, not investment advice.

dex.description: Filter to one builder dex by name (the part before ':' in market names).

spotRefs.description: Optional map of coin symbol -> external spot price for basis calculation.

name: hl_hip3_analytics
title: HIP-3 market analytics
